news_app.tests module¶

class news_app.tests.NewsApiTests(methodName='runTest')¶

Bases: TestCase

API and workflow tests for the news application.

setUp()¶

Create role users and seed publisher/article/newsletter data.

test_article_form_lists_assigned_publishers_and_independent()¶

Journalists choose an assigned publisher or Independent.

test_dashboard_renders_for_each_role()¶

Dashboard must render without template errors for every role.

test_editor_can_approve_article()¶

Editor approval triggers callback and marks article approved.

test_editor_can_create_publisher_and_assign_members()¶

Editors can manage publisher membership in the website.

test_editor_can_delete_article()¶

Editors can delete any article.

test_editor_registration_is_immediately_available()¶

Editors can operate a blank database without account approval.

test_home_page_lists_approved_articles_and_newsletters()¶

Home page should render approved content lists.

test_journalist_can_create_article()¶

Journalists can create new unapproved articles.

test_journalist_can_create_update_delete_own_newsletter()¶

Journalists can fully manage their own newsletters.

test_journalist_can_delete_own_article_from_website()¶

Journalists can delete their own articles from the dashboard.

test_journalist_can_update_article()¶

Journalists can update their own articles.

test_journalist_cannot_approve_via_put()¶

Journalists cannot set approved status through API updates.

test_later_editor_registration_is_also_immediately_available()¶

Later elevated accounts do not require account approval.

test_newsletter_role_permissions()¶

Readers can view newsletters but cannot create them.

test_non_reader_cannot_access_subscribed_endpoint()¶

Only readers should use the subscribed endpoint.

test_publisher_create_page_lists_existing_publishers()¶

The publisher creation page lists already-created publishers.

test_reader_article_page_shows_subscription_controls()¶

Readers see article publisher and journalist subscription options.

test_reader_can_list_approved_articles()¶

Readers can call the approved article listing endpoint.

test_reader_can_list_only_subscribed_articles()¶

Subscribed endpoint returns only matching subscriptions.

test_reader_can_unsubscribe_from_article_page()¶

Article-level subscription controls support unsubscribe.

test_reader_cannot_approve_article()¶

Readers cannot use the approval workflow endpoint.

test_reader_cannot_create_article()¶

Readers cannot create articles.

test_reader_cannot_delete_article()¶

Readers cannot delete articles.

test_registration_rejects_duplicate_email()¶

Registration must not allow an email address to be reused.

test_unauthenticated_cannot_list_articles()¶

Unauthenticated requests should be rejected by token auth.
